item.title: Quantum Layers Improve Vision AI Accuracy to 80.7% on Spatial Reasoning Tasks
item.description: Accuracy increased by 2. 28 percentage points on visual spatial reasoning tasks when a simulated quantum layer was inserted after the visual projector, an improvement over traditional machine learning methods. Replacing one component with its quantum counterpart retained nearly 80% accuracy while reducing trainable parameters by 13.

item.title: Researchers Build Mirror Reflecting 99.82% of Light
item.description: A mirror reflecting 99. 82% of light while vibrating with exceptional precision was previously unattainable, a trade-off inherent in current designs. Now, newly created nanopillar surfaces achieve both, reaching performance on par with leading ultracoherent systems but with dramatically increased reflectivity.
